status: PROPOSED - first draft of Mara Venn's field book for the owner's test, not approved
title: Field notes
inscription: For the new Wayfinder. When the lanterns called, the woods used to answer. Now they have gone quiet, and I can't yet tell you why. I've left questions where I don't know the answer. I hope you'll fill them in. Watch first, then help. The wild owes us nothing.

pages.mara: Driftfin feels water before we can see it. When it goes quiet and starts to bob, something nearby is damp. Let it lead you now and then.
Glintle turns to face things we can't hear. I once watched one hold still for an hour. What is it listening to? Tell me if you find out.
Quick, shy and always busy. Tumbletail gathers fallen seeds and tucks them away. Don't rush it. If you run, it will be gone before you've said hello.

clues.ask: Where does it keep its food?
clues.answer: Seeds, hidden by the bench. They keep getting scattered.
I tidied its seeds. It noticed.

clues.ask: Will it ever come to an open hand?
clues.answer: Once it was calm, it leaned into my hand.

pages.startled: I ran at it and it bolted. Next time, slowly.
pages.refused: It wouldn't come near while it was frightened.
pages.knocked: I hurt it. It wants nothing to do with me now.
pages.joined: It chose to come with me.

pages.mara: Slow and patient, and easy to overlook. Mossmelt cleans fallen leaves and helps the fungi grow. It will not be hurried, so don't try. Bring your patience.

clues.answer: Its feeding bed sits by the tree, buried in debris.

clues.ask: What does it need from us?
clues.answer: I cleared the debris and it rose to greet me.
It settled beside me when I sat still.
It calmed, and came to my hand.

pages.startled: It flattened itself when I ran close.
pages.refused: It wouldn't answer me while it was frightened.
pages.knocked: I went too far. It needs space.
pages.joined: It chose to come with me.
